chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
"The days of Udhiyah (sacrifice) are three days, and the best of them is the first of them."
ai.seo_question: What are the days of Eid al-Adha sacrifice and which is the best day?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the temporal scope of the Eid al-Adha sacrifice, confirming the three-day period (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah) while emphasizing the superiority of the first day. In Shia jurisprudence, this distinction highlights the preference for early performance to ensure the ritual is completed before the final day, aligning with the Prophetic tradition of maximizing the reward of the initial days of sacrifice.
